lines.369680623409377285: Now, why don’t you take a seat and stretch your legs for a bit.
lines.369680623413571584: The show is just about to start. Eddie Velvet is playing. I know you don’t want to miss that.
lines.369680623413571585: Take a seat and put your feet up.
lines.369680623421960192: I’ll be seeing you down the road, partner.
lines.369680623421960193: Good to see you again, partner.
lines.369680623426154496: You were at the Rabbit Hole.
lines.369680623426154499: I’m not one to look the other way when someone is in a bad spot.
lines.369680623430348801: It's a dark night and it wants to eat you alive.
lines.369680623430348803: Don't worry. I’ve got your back.
lines.369680623430348804: What do you mean? You'll help me?
lines.369680623430348805: That's right. I don’t know what’s happening here, and I don’t need to know.
lines.369680623434543104: We shoot first and ask questions later. I’ll work my end and you’ll work yours.
lines.369680623434543105: Does that sound about right to you?
lines.369680623438737408: Right now I could use all the help I can get. I can't tell you how much I appreciate your support.
lines.369680623438737410: It's like I'm stuck in a nightmare and I don't know how to wake up.
lines.369680623442931712: There now. We'll figure this out. Sure, it's grim out there but you'll come out on top. I'll make sure of it.
lines.369680623442931713: I've got something for you. See it as a token of good luck. Hope you get some use out of it.
lines.369680623442931714: Maybe our paths will cross later on. It’s a good night for riding, don’t you think?
lines.369680623447126017: Didn’t mean to let you down, partner.
lines.369680623447126019: This is as far as I go.
lines.369680623455514624: You're going to have to finish this on your own.
lines.369680623455514626: It's all connected to him somehow.  I just don't know how.
lines.369680623455514627: Well, I think you know everything you need to know.
lines.369680623455514628: You have to put him down.
lines.369680623459708928: No second thoughts. There's no room for that.
lines.369680623459708929: It's the only way to end to all of this.
lines.369680623459708930: I'll just rest here for a bit. I'd do more if I could, but I don't think I have it in me.
lines.369680623493263360: I thought you were dead. I saw you... What happened?
lines.369680623493263361: This place is not always what it seems to be. I figure you've guessed as much by now.
lines.369680623501651968: I don't know what to expect anymore.
lines.369680623501651969: Everything comes to an end, and yours is just up ahead. Are you ready for a final rodeo?
lines.369680623501651970: After that, it's time for the happy forever after.
lines.369680623501651971: I don't know if I'm ready. Do you think it'll be all right?
lines.369680623501651972: You've made someone very angry, so you'll have to deal with that as best you can.
